_comment_1: This stub marks the slot where the census-derived geometry mix plugs in. The mix is drawn from an operator-keyed census (trigger-fraction, width and filter distributions); those source numbers are not vendored here and are not restated in any captured output.
_comment_2: The live production draw is in production_sweep.py, which resolves the census artefact by path at runtime. This stub is retained as the record of the convention: published artefacts carry recovery curves and draw shape only, never the census tables.
